# Step 1 — create seed (`demo/1-seed`)

**Open:** `docs/implementation-plans/plan-seeds/due-dates.md`

**Decision to explain:** the seed carries decisions and an explicit scope fence
(Outcome, In scope, Out of scope, Allowed behavior changes, Testing, Stop / defer);
the pipeline manufactures the detail. Correct the seed or approve plan creation.

**Live version:** a seed is authored with an assistant, not generated by a
plan-tool verb. Ask your coding assistant:

> Inspect this repository and draft `docs/implementation-plans/plan-seeds/due-dates.md`
> using SEED_FORMAT.md: tasks gain an optional due date and `todo list --overdue`
> shows open tasks past due. Include a scope fence. Link it and wait for my review.

**Baked state:** this branch already contains the reviewed seed.
**Next:** `./step.sh next`
